content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Virginia Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's education and hours-worked thresholds, then gather documentation of your background. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you confirm you meet the credential requirements before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions online at times that fit your schedule, interact with active certified practitioners, and build knowledge across all five process groups. All 35 required contact hours are delivered in real time with full instructor support.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you've completed the course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Include your education credentials, work experience, and proof of the 35 contact hours. Pay PMI's exam fee and await approval—typically within days to one week.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and study guides, to solidify your readiness. Schedule your test at a PMI-authorized testing center. Sit for the exam on your timeline and receive your pass or fail result immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, you'll enter PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, leading projects, volunteering, or publishing work. Submit your renewal application and fee before your credential expires to stay current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
